name: Tajamin
aliases: Keeper of the Book of Keld
description: Uses her holy cudgel to melt the glacier on which the battle is fought.

timeline.summary: Tajamin shatters the frozen lake with her sacred cudgel, sinking most of both armies.
timeline.quote: In this time of greatest atrocity, Doyenne Tajamin cast her sacred cudgel into the frozen lake, shattering it into a thousand pieces.

citation.text: "Keld", section "The Keldon Twilight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tajamin strikes a risen hero and the cudgel catches fire.
timeline.quote: was shocked to feel the cudgel catch fire beneath her fingers

citation.text: "Keldon Twilight", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tajamin hurls the cudgel down, melting the glacier and flooding the battlefield.
timeline.quote: The cudgel's divine heat shattered the ice, melting the glacier in a violent surge of scalding water.

citation.text: "Keldon Twilight", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Golden Argosy arrives and rescues survivors.
timeline.quote: The ship’s crew pulled many survivors

citation.text: "Keldon Twilight", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tajamin's cudgel triggers an eruption and flood, and the Golden Argosy rescues the remaining warriors and takes them to Urborg.
timeline.quote: The mythical Keldon longboat Golden Argosy emerged from the depths and saved the remaining warriors of Keld

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "Uniter of Keld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Keld fallen Keldon heroes return fighting for Phyrexia; Tajamin melts the glacier, drowning Phyrexians, and the Golden Argosy saves most Keldons and elves and carries them to Urborg.
timeline.quote: Doyenne Tajamin uses her holy cudgel to melt the entire glacier on which the battle is being fought.

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Olvresk takes Astor from Treulk and sends him to train under Tajamin.
timeline.quote: Olvresk took him from Treulk and sent Astor to train under Doyenne Tajamin

citation.text: "Astor", section "Astor's Beginnings". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Disagreeing with Tajamin's methods, Olvresk storms her compound and his Fists slaughter many of her people; Tajamin saves herself and Astor by invoking the Tinder Spell.
timeline.quote: He stormed Tajamin's compound and used his Fists, his elite soldiers, to slaughter many of Tajamin's people.

citation.text: "Astor", section "Astor's Beginnings". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Astor learns the Tinder Spell in two days without food, and Tajamin teaches him of Jezal's Covenant.
timeline.quote: Two days later, Astor knew the spell

citation.text: "Astor", section "Astor's Beginnings". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At nineteen Astor is granted the far northern lands by Olvresk and sets out to confront a dragon that seems to have broken her oath.
timeline.quote: Astor had been granted the lands of the far north

citation.text: "Astor", section "Keldon Staredown". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: When the Rathi Overlay begins, Freyalise plants the Skyshroud Forest in Keld; Astor meets Eladamri and takes him in, uniting Keldons and Skyshroud elves.
timeline.quote: Astor accepted the elf and began to teach him the ways of Keld

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tajamin strikes an undead champion with her cudgel, triggering an eruption and flood; the Golden Argosy saves the survivors and carries them toward Urborg.
timeline.quote: Tajamin struck one of the undead with her sacred cudgel

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Doyenne Tajamin strikes a Witch King, triggering a volcanic eruption and flood.
timeline.quote: Doyenne Tajamin striking one of the Witch Kings with her sacred cudgel

citation.text: "Keldon Necropolis", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Olvresk takes Astor from Treulk and sends him to train under Tajamin.
timeline.quote: Olvresk took him from Treulk and sent Astor to train under Doyenne Tajamin

citation.text: "Olvresk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Olvresk stormed Tajamin's compound with his Fists and slaughtered many; Tajamin saves herself and Astor by proposing Olvresk teach the Tinder Spell.
timeline.quote: He stormed Tajamin's compound and used his Fists, his elite soldiers, to slaughter many of Tajamin's people.

citation.text: "Olvresk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Astor learns the spell in two days without food; Tajamin tells him of Jezal's Covenant.
timeline.quote: Two days later, Astor knew the spell

citation.text: "Olvresk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
